purpose: Independent synthetic verification of finite-candidate certificates and repeated coordination; not a replacement for the restricted 10000-case validation
method_order: Four-position cycle over the 12 fixed test identifiers
reuse: Six coordination problems per valid candidate baseline; cached/rebuilt order alternates by scenario and variant. Both paths use fresh scipy.linprog calls; only certificate construction differs.

implementation_correction.description: Use actual P_xy=d+4*e*x+2*e*y in derivative bound, checked by an exact finite-difference Hessian test. Earlier exported bounds also passed full-box rational verification. All small comparisons are regenerated; inputs, MILP starts and every configuration parameter are unchanged.
